pairs.subject: seal-and-key-hierarchy
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/resources/external_api_keys.rs:3 The context issues bearer tokens and persists only their one-way SHA-256 digest, with no encrypted store, data key, keyring, root key or seal; a grep of src/features/settings/sub_api_keys/ for unseal/keyring/encrypt/cipher/rotate/root_key returned zero files, so the subject's precondition (a server encrypting its own store under a key hierarchy) does not hold here.
